rationale: The answer is grounded in the current checkout and nearly every cited symbol/line range checks out. Verified: ExtensionManifestV1 at plugin-sdk/src/plugin-host/shared/types.ts:233-253 (apiVersion v1, kind, id, permissions, entrypoints); ExtensionHost two-layer permission and kit/binding/capability lifecycle in core.ts; Electron host constructed at host/index.ts:236 with `new ExtensionHost({ runtime: 'electron' })` and no permissionResolver, so core.ts:250-255 falls back to `permissionResolver?.() ?? manifest.permissions` (request-granted) — the security gap is real; FileSystemLoader `await import(entrypoint)` at runtimes/node/loaders/fs.ts:72-76; node/web runtimes throw 'not implemented' for websocket/node-worker; server-runtime createServer default port 6121 (server/index.ts:109); server-sdk client announce/authenticate/registry-sync/heartbeat/reconnect and superjson codec; channel-server TLS/QR/rollback; 6 services and 5 root plugins using server-sdk; extension.airi.json discovery + Valibot validation (registry.ts:62-165); eventa:invoke/event:electron naming and the hand-copied plugin types with TODO at capabilities.ts:42-44; desktop-overlay AIRI_DESKTOP_OVERLAY=1 gate and forced injeca.invoke at index.ts:244-258; beat-sync show:false. Current desktop is Electron; the legacy Tauri crates/ directory is absent from this checkout and the answer does not treat it as current. Two minor, non-decision-affecting imprecisions: the '14 window modules' count (12 are wired in index.ts) and the channel-server 357-449 line range for QR/rollback. No documentation-vs-implementation drift was found; the answer does not rely on stale documentation. The review covers all nine dimensions at full strength: it states confidence from maturity levels, cites evidence densely, explains friction (manual wiring, dual protocols, in-process third-party execution), ranks options A/B/C with quality-attribute trade-offs and rollback, and gives a concrete phase-0-3 migration with test commands and acceptance criteria. Gate passes (0 material errors, 0 unresolved decision conflicts).
